title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Zenodo report, MIT. Day-ahead GB national demand, 960 days (16 Mar 2024 to 31 Oct 2026). Three zero-shot models and a weekly-lag regression got the same ECMWF forecast weather. Weather cut error 34% regression, 32% Chronos-2, 23% Timestral, 6% TimesFM 2.5. Plan frozen 10 Nov 2026 before scoring. Models' no-weather edge over the regression mostly goes away. Training overlap possible.

title: gb-foundation-model-tests (repository README)
note: Public MIT repo: plans, lock files, deviation log, results. First study (no weather, 1,035 days): error ratio to regression 0.928 Chronos-2, 0.910 Timestral, 1.009 TimesFM 2.5; pre-set 10% bar not shown cleared. Weather study: all forecasters got the same day-ahead weather forecasts. Weights fetched at pinned revisions. Last commit date not visible.

title: Weather study results note (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: 960 daily origins, MAE in MW. With/without weather: regression 0.658 (0.631-0.686), Chronos-2 0.683 (0.658-0.707), Timestral 0.773 (0.751-0.796), TimesFM 2.5 0.941 (0.913-0.968); all pass at 0.0125. Model/regression, both with weather: Chronos-2 0.966 (0.931-1.001), Timestral 1.074 (1.034-1.115), TimesFM 2.5 1.453 (1.394-1.510). No MAPE.

title: Pre-registered plan, weather study (weather_study/PLAN.md)
note: Plan agreed 8 Nov 2026, amended 9 Nov (date given here; tag timestamp not on page). Only confirmatory test: each forecaster's MAE with weather over without, one-sided, four tests at 0.0125. Model-vs-regression with weather is not confirmatory. ECMWF 00 UTC run of D-1 plus ERA5 history; temperature, wind, solar. Block bootstrap, 90% intervals. Live window to 31 Mar 2027 is descriptive.

title: amazon/chronos-2 model card
note: Apache-2.0 model card. Zero-shot forecaster, about 120M parameters, takes past and known-future covariates natively. Loaded with the chronos-forecasting package (2.0 or later). Card says CPU inference is supported but shows only GPU examples. Links its paper, dated 17 Oct 2025; the weights' own release or commit date is not shown on the card.
